energy_source: CBECI annualised TWh → daily kWh = TWh*1e9/365
interpretation: The ~$3.30bn figure on analysis_ready 2019-01-01 is NOT an external mysterious seed. It is the cumsum of daily_cost_usd from complete panel start 2018-01-01 through 2019-01-01 under the panel electricity_price (near-constant 0.076234375). Pre-2018 mining cost is NOT included (complete starts 2018-01-01 with cum=daily).
